en.hubeali: H 14742 – Wuheyb, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following:
I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Statement of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic: “[23:60] And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid”

, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is for their intercession, and their hopes, they (our<sup>asws</sup> shias) fear that their (good) deeds would be rejected (and thrown) back to them if they had not obeyed (with total submission to) Allah<sup>azwj</sup> but they are hoping that these would be Accepted from our<sup>asws</sup> (intercession)’.
en.sarwar: 294. Wuheyb, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.) about the Statement of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic:
“[23:60] And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid”,

he (a.s.) said: ‘This is for their intercession, and their hopes, they (our (a.s.) shias) fear that their (good) deeds would be rejected (and thrown) back to them if they had not obeyed (with total submission to) Allah (azwj) but they are hoping that these would be Accepted from our (a.s.) (intercession)’.
